```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Day 27: Automated BTC Risk Report — single cell

# 1) Libraries
library(tidyquant)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(PerformanceAnalytics)
library(knitr)

# 2) Parameters
symbol <- "BTC-USD"
start  <- "2023-01-01"
end    <- Sys.Date()

# 3) Data (prices & returns)
btc_tbl <- tq_get(symbol, from = start, to = end) |>
  arrange(date) |>
  transmute(date, price = adjusted) |>
  mutate(ret = log(price / lag(price))) |>
  tidyr::drop_na()

ret_xts <- xts::xts(btc_tbl$ret, order.by = btc_tbl$date)

# 4) Price Chart
price_plot <- ggplot(btc_tbl, aes(x = date, y = price)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = paste("Price of", symbol),
       x = "Date", y = "Price (USD)") +
  theme_minimal()

# 5) Return Distribution
dist_plot <- ggplot(btc_tbl, aes(x = ret)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "darkred", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Daily Log Return Distribution",
       x = "Log Return", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal()

# 6) Risk Metrics (VaR & ES) — PerformanceAnalytics uses tail prob p
risk_table <- data.frame(
  Measure = c("VaR(95%)", "ES(95%)", "VaR(99%)", "ES(99%)"),
  Value = c(
    as.numeric(VaR(ret_xts, p = 0.05, method = "historical")),
    as.numeric(ES (ret_xts, p = 0.05, method = "historical")),
    as.numeric(VaR(ret_xts, p = 0.01, method = "historical")),
    as.numeric(ES (ret_xts, p = 0.01, method = "historical"))
  )
)

# 7) Output
print(price_plot)
print(dist_plot)
kable(risk_table, caption = "Risk Metrics for BTC-USD")
```
